_comment: Columns every domain pack gets (Mickey, 2026-10-26): which paper a row comes from. A pack whose template already has a column keeps the template's place for it; the rest come right after the template, before the pack's own standard columns. Written only when filled.

columns.description: Title of the paper the row was extracted from
arXiv ID and version of the text that was read, when the paper was read from arXiv (a preprint)
